newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Vontobel says Q1 results above benchmark.
newsitem.headline: Vontobel says Q1 results above benchmark.

text.p: Vontobel Holding AG said its profits in the first three months of 1997 exceeded budget targets as well as the levels of the same period a year ago.
"The Vontobel group performed well in the first quarter of 1997. At the end of March, all income figures were clearly above budget and the year-ago levels," a Vontobel statement said.

Vontobel said the first quarter confirmed its good performance in 1996, when annual net profit excluding minorities rose 47 percent to 60.2 million Swiss francs and return on equity (ROE) rose to 13.5 percent and 9.8 percent.
Vontobel reported its 1996 results on February 6.
